project.title: Use of magnetite-embedded granules in treating the semiconductor wastewater
project.description: This project investigated the effect of magnetite embedment in the granules on methananogenesis in treating semiconductor wastewaters: tetramethylammonium hydroxide, ethyl lactate, and dimethyl sulfoxide
project.center_name: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)
